definitions.explanation: A set of cards used for card games, typically 52 cards in four suits.

examples.japanese: トランプで{遊|あそ}ぼう。
examples.notes: トランプで遊ぶ = to play cards

examples.japanese: トランプを{切|き}って{配|くば}った。
examples.english: I shuffled and dealt the cards.
examples.notes: トランプを切る = to shuffle cards

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、{家族|かぞく}でよくトランプをした。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played cards with my family.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: トランプ comes from the English word "trump" (a winning card in card games). In Japanese, it refers to playing cards in general, not just trump cards.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・トランプをする (to play cards)
・トランプを{切|き}る (to shuffle cards)
・トランプを{配|くば}る (to deal cards)
・トランプゲーム (card game)

CARD GAMES:
・ばば{抜|ぬ}き (Old Maid)
・{七|しち}{並|なら}べ (Sevens)
・ポーカー (poker)
・{神経|しんけい}{衰弱|すいじゃく} (Concentration/Memory)
